goal: Resolve bounded exact-version Skill composition and emit safe three-mode IR.

architecture.path: existing SkillGraphRepository -> SkillCompositionPlanner -> immutable Domain plan/IR
preservedInvariants: No second Skill graph or workflow runtime is introduced
Every fixed and slot edge is graph-authorized and exact-versioned
Procedure output is declarative IR and is not Workflow DSL or executable source
No v1.1 Provider state, protocol SDK type or persistence authority is copied

testsActuallyRun.command: vitest run composition and formal-package regression

failureSemantics.recoverable: parent recovering; try an allowed recovery
failureSemantics.degraded: continue degraded only with explicit missing effect or evidence

knownLimitations: Composition plans and IR are not persisted, exposed, compiled or executed in Phase 5.
Real v1.1 readiness integration remains deferred to Phase 8.
External production Provider interoperability is unverified.
